compositionEvidence.summary: Attempt 2 draft restores all seven accepted packaged parts, preserving the pale paper field and adding the missing vertical ink-anchor hierarchy while keeping the supplied camera unchanged.
compositionEvidence.motionInterpretation: steady-grid-pulse remains optional and capture-still readable; no unrelated animation added
decisions: Supplied camera returned unchanged; framing was solved through accepted part root params only.

Attempt 1 desktop, mobile, and surround-360 previews were inspected: the paper field and dense horizontal mark system were readable, but the accepted ink-anchor-masses part was absent from the draft and the vertical gestural anchor requirement was underrepresented.

Added only the accepted packaged ink-anchor-masses module at renderOrder 4 with a modest root scale and near-center offset so black vertical strokes and central pressure support the field without becoming a literal subject.
Kept matte-void-atmosphere and world environment pale, high-key, and absorbent so negative space stays active rather than turning into a dark or glossy container.
Kept outputColorTransform subtle (contrast 1.07, saturation 0.99, exposure 1.02, vignette 0.035) as final display grading only; no renderer post/color pipeline or shader assumptions were introduced.
The inherited matte-void-atmosphere UV console warning is accepted-part evidence; compatibility is preserved through packaged WebGPU-compatible module refs and renderer preview evidence.

takeaways: Use fixed-camera screenshot comparison and piece transforms rather than camera changes for framing repair.
Treat output grading as final display contrast, not a substitute for mark hierarchy or exposure repair.
Validate desktop, mobile, and surround-360 evidence before final handoff; negative space can remain intentional when front composition carries the abstract field.

partAdaptations.summary: Kept as quiet WebGPU-safe support at origin with non-dominant paper-field context; no creative ownership change.
Kept as the primary pale paper depth field, scaled to preserve visible matte ground and negative-space readability.
Kept as the selected-news transformation, scaled forward enough for the broken Return path to remain readable inside the denser field.
Restored the accepted large-mark hierarchy that was missing from attempt 1: vertical anchors, dense black pressure, and dry-brush masses now sit behind/through the radial and fracture marks.
Kept as distributed symbolic form system, slightly behind the fracture circuit so radial signs organize the field without replacing the news cue.
Kept near the primary band as small repetitive dry scratch/rub texture that contrasts with the restored large anchors.
Kept as subtle value/cadence support; capture mode remains still-readable and no generic glow or fast animation was added.
